newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Dec first 10 days surplus cut by imports-MOF.
newsitem.headline: Japan Dec first 10 days surplus cut by imports-MOF.

text.p: A sharp fall in Japan's trade surplus in the first 10 days of December was mainly due to a surge in imports, particularly of crude oil, a Finance Ministry official told Reuters.

The ministry announced that Japan's customs-cleared trade surplus fell 96.6 percent from a year earlier to 8.07 billion yen in the first 10 days of December. Imports rose 31.0 percent, while exports rose 4.4 percent.
"The trade surplus fluctuates wildly in the first 10 days of each month. A sharp increase in imports, especially of crude oil, could be the cause of the drop in the surplus," he said.
